undo.unexportBody: Voucher {voucher} stays in Fortnox. All this does is stop the app counting the day as exported. Export again and you get a second voucher, so reverse the first one in Fortnox before you do.
undo.reopenBody: The voucher and the booked income statement are deleted, and the day rejoins the To book queue. It waits there until you book it again, or until the next fetch clears the queue.
undo.deleteBody: {unit} is removed, with its sold items and its voucher.
undo.reopenDone: The kontering is undone. The day waits to be konterad again.

findings.none: Nothing out of the ordinary. Compare the products sold with the income statement and approve.
findings.unplaced: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} matched no prefix and went to the fallback. Give them the right committee, or leave them if they belong there.
findings.noCostCenter: {count, plural, one {# line has} other {# lines have}} no cost centre. Choose one on the line before approving.
findings.inactive: Cost centre {codes} is archived in Fortnox and would stop the export. Choose another on those lines.
findings.local: {codes} are local cost centres. They reach Fortnox as text on the row, not as a cost centre.

review.noCostCenterShort: {count, plural, one {# without cost centre} other {# without cost centre}}

book.unknownClearingAccount: The clearing account {account} is not in the chart of accounts. Fix it under Settings → Income before booking.
book.voucherDerived: One row per account and cost centre. Change the lines above to change the voucher.
book.clearingHint: The clearing account follows from how the day was paid and cannot be changed here.

setup.titleBook: You can fetch income, but before you can book it

steps.service: Connect Zettle. Whoever runs the app needs to set ZETTLE_CLIENT_ID and ZETTLE_API_KEY. Swish can be fetched without it.
steps.noCommittees: Turn on sales for at least one result unit, so there is a committee to book the income to.
steps.noPrefixes: Add product prefixes to the committee. A product whose name starts with the prefix is booked to its account, so c picks up c-Cola, for example.
steps.noFallback: Choose the fallback for unknown products: which committee and which account products without a prefix are booked to.
steps.swishClearing: Choose the clearing account for Swish.
steps.zettleClearing: Choose the clearing account for Zettle.
steps.zettleFee: Choose the account for Zettle's fees.

setup.askAdmin: The steps are done under Settings → Sales, which only people with access to settings can reach. Ask someone who has it.

blocker.noClearingAccount: No clearing account is chosen. Choose it under Settings → Sales.
blocker.unknownClearingAccount: Clearing account {account} is not in the chart of accounts.
blocker.noFeeAccount: No account for Zettle's fees is chosen. Choose it under Settings → Sales.
blocker.unknownAccount: A line has an account that is not in the chart.
blocker.noCostCenter: A line has no cost centre.
blocker.inactiveCostCenter: A line has an archived cost centre.
blocker.noDistributions: The day has nothing to book.
blocker.unbalanced: The day's total does not match its lines.
blocker.manualStale: The kontering was written before the lines changed. Save it again or reset it.
blocker.manualInvalid: The hand-written kontering cannot be booked.
blocker.unknownProject: A row has a project Fortnox does not have.

manual.editing: Write the kontering by hand. The clearing row follows the day's total and cannot be changed.
manual.stale: The lines have changed since the kontering was written by hand. Save it again or reset it before booking.
manual.resetDone: The kontering follows the lines again.

blocker.negativeAmounts: Amounts cannot be negative. Use the other side instead.
blocker.costCenterRequired: Rows on result accounts (3000 to 8999) need a cost centre.
blocker.unbalanced: Debit and credit do not balance.
